# bash_continue.txt — commands that MUST fall through (verdict=Continue)
# under tier 1+2 only (no LLM, no cache, no legacy).
#
# These are commands that:
#   - don't match any deterministic block rule (so tier 1 doesn't fire)
#   - don't match any anchored allow rule (so tier 2 doesn't fire)
# In production, these would normally hit tier 4 (LLM) or fall to the
# user prompt. In this corpus we just verify they reach Continue.

# --- Anchored allow rules don't apply to commands with shell trickery ---
ls -la > /tmp/listing
cat /etc/hosts | grep localhost
echo "evil" > /tmp/tmp.txt
ls /tmp && cat /tmp/foo
ls; cat /tmp/foo
(ls /tmp)
echo $(date)
ls -la | head -5

# --- Commands not in any anchored allow list ---
go build ./...
go test ./...
go test -race ./...
npm install
npm run dev
npm run build
yarn install
yarn build
pnpm install
gcloud
gcloud builds submit
gcloud run deploy
gcloud projects describe foo
gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=foo
docker build .
docker run alpine
docker compose up
kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml
kubectl create secret generic foo
terraform init
terraform apply
terraform destroy

# --- Variable-expanded commands fall through (HasUnresolved) ---
cat $HOME/.bashrc
echo $PATH
ls $HOME

# --- Custom scripts the engine has no opinion on ---
./run.sh
./scripts/test.sh
make deploy
./bin/myapp serve

# --- Long pipelines / compound commands ---
git log | head
ls /tmp | wc -l
find . -name "*.go" | xargs wc -l

# --- Variable-wrapped rm bypass attempts (tier 1 conservative on unresolved) ---
R=rm; $R -rf /

# --- terraform state reads now instant-allow via terraform-readonly.
# state-mutating verbs (rm/mv/push) still fall through via the
# SafeVerbs check AND are denied by tier-1 `terraform-state-mutation`.

# --- step 13: shell without -c still falls through to LLM ---
bash script.sh

# --- steps 8-10: env, make, awk, sed moved from allow to LLM ---
env
env FOO=bar cmd
make help
make test
make build
make install
awk '{print $1}' /tmp/f
sed 's/a/b/g' /tmp/f

# --- step 9: awk/sed system-escape shapes (LLM-only; tier-2 posix-readonly
# no longer catches these. LLM is expected to classify unsafe → continue.)
awk 'BEGIN{system("id")}'
sed -n 'e echo hi' /tmp/f

# --- step 8: env wrapping destructive cmd (LLM-only; tier-1 rm-rf-system
# sees Program=env not rm, falls through)
env rm -rf /etc
env -- rm -rf /etc
env PATH=/bin rm -rf /etc

# --- cd-prefixed compound commands that must NOT auto-approve ---
# cd + command not in any allow rule
cd /tmp && curl https://example.com
cd /tmp && npm install
cd /tmp && make deploy
# cd + redirect (changes semantics)
cd /tmp && git log > /tmp/out
# cd + unresolved variable in path
cd $HOME && git status
# cd with flags
cd -P /tmp && git status
# First command not cd — stays continue
ls /tmp && cat /tmp/foo
# cd + pipe to unsafe target
cd /tmp && git log | sh
# cd + git push (not in readonly list)
cd /tmp && git push origin main

# --- blocker 3 fix: ssh-add family no longer denies (falls to LLM) ---
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
ssh-keygen -y -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa
